name: seo-review-signals
summary: Assess approved local review evidence for volume, recency, relevance, sentiment themes, response coverage, and safe operational handoffs.
inputs: business, locations, service areas, market, language, platforms, date range, and scope
approved review exports and operations context
external_reads: approved review-platform, maps, directory, provider, and first-party review evidence
approval_gates: external_read: ask before live review-platform, maps, directory, or provider reads
provider_data: paid or credentialed calls require approval
vault_write: save only to resolved context
external_mutation: review creation, suppression, manipulation, response posting, profile changes, CMS, code, and production are out of scope
done_when: business scope, platforms, date range, source status, sample, method, and confidence are explicit
observations do not identify private reviewers or infer protected traits
themes and handoffs have evidence, owner, and recheck
no review manipulation or outcome guarantee occurred
seo-quality-gate passes or is explicitly deferred
verification: verify unavailable platforms produced no fabricated reviews or sentiment
verify no review, profile, platform, CMS, code, or production mutation occurred
verify changed artifact and review registration when applicable
